name: Salesforce Agentic Maturity Model
licence: Salesforce's; quoted briefly with the source
caveat: A vendor's news story with no scoring rubric. Its lists of how to advance are advice, not tests.

name: Enterprise Agentic AI Maturity Model (EAAMM)
licence: the author's; quoted briefly with the source
caveat: One author; a convenience sample of 136 who rated themselves. Its five levels are the five user roles of Feng, McDonald and Zhang, Levels of Autonomy for AI Agents (arXiv 2506.12469), which we have not yet read at source.

name: State of Agentic AI Security and Governance 2.01
rates: the deployed agent (tier) and the organisation (governance)
caveat: Its matrix is described by OWASP as a self-assessment and roadmapping tool, not a binding compliance verdict.

name: Model Context Protocol, Authorization (draft)
licence: the project's; requirements quoted with the source
caveat: A draft page. Fifteen requirements chosen by us as a first cut, not the whole specification. It applies only where an endpoint of this kind is published.

name: Agentic AI Governance Maturity Model (AAGMM)
licence: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0: cited by domain name only, not adapted
caveat: One independent author; validated by simulation (750 runs), not in production. Only its twelve domain names are used here.

name: Agentic AI adoption maturity model
licence: Microsoft's; quoted briefly with the source
caveat: A self-assessment that refers to Microsoft products. The 88 items are the bullets of its quick reference table, as the page served them.

name: AI Risk Management Framework 1.0, subcategories
rates: the organisation and the AI system
licence: a United States government work; freely reusable
caveat: About AI in general, not agents. The 72 subcategories are taken from NIST's playbook data file.

name: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (the AI Act), selected articles
rates: the AI system, its provider and its deployer
caveat: Eleven articles chosen by us, by title only. Most bind only for high-risk systems. A later amending regulation exists and is not reflected. This is not a legal reading.
